import asyncio
async def producer(queue):
    for i in range(3):
        await queue.put(i)
    await queue.put(None)
async def consumer(queue):
    results = []
    while True:
        item = await queue.get()
        if item is None:
            break
        results.append(item)
    return results
async def main():
    queue = asyncio.Queue()
    prod = asyncio.create_task(producer(queue))
    cons = asyncio.create_task(consumer(queue))
    result = await cons
    await prod
    return result
print(asyncio.run(main()))
